en: Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views of an old Ottoman‑style public fountain in an urban setting. Both images show a stone Turkish fountain with arched niche and trough, cobbled street, nearby buildings, and people in early 20th‑century clothing. The captions underneath identify the location as Salonique and describe the subject as a Turkish fountain in French and English. There are circular postal cancellation marks at the top, and light aging stains around the edges.
